text_block_list.text:
—Thanks to Master,
Gran Alegria's training progressed smoothly.

We're conducting training that further develops
and brings out her immense potential.
choice_data_list: (The problem is... "feel," huh.)
(The problem is... "feel," right.)

text_block_list.text: A genius through and through, Gran Alegria has absolute confidence in her abilities—her legs and her "intuition".

However, if confidence turns to overconfidence
and she runs recklessly like in that mock race...
she could suffer an irreversible injury.

"To prevent that, I really need
to understand her 'sensations'..."
choice_data_list: (So even watching how she runs didn't work, huh)
(Even watching how she runs didn't work, did it)

text_block_list.text:
If analysis won't cut it... should I experience it firsthand?
But I can't run like her...
choice_data_list: (...Then, how about setting your own rules?)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
It's pretty rare for you to join me for warm-ups!
choice_data_list: Yeah! I plan to keep accompanying you from now on, is that okay?
Yeah! I plan to keep accompanying you from now on, is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse!
A 100-miler is super welcome♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: We're heeere!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
To finish off our roadwork, we do the
"GIRLS' LEGEND U" pose in the stands!
choice_data_list: 'GIRLS' LEGEND U'... Is this how it goes?
'GIRLS' LEGEND U'... Like this?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Ah, with more snap!
choice_data_list: Nice and crisp...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's completely wrong!
You do it like this! Bam!
choice_data_list: *Snap!*

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: That's why I said, not "on point"...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer, have you ever danced to "GIRLS' LEGEND U"?

『Don't stop!
No, don't stop'til finish!!』
choice_data_list: Wooo-ooo-ooo-wooooh!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: !? T-Trainer-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Why are you practicing dancing, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, so you're trying to experience
Gran Alegria's personal rules firsthand..."
choice_data_list: There's no other way to get a "feel" for it.

text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it'll work.
But we have to try everything we possibly can!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In that case... why not watch her dance
and try copying her?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has their own personal quirks when dancing.
Perhaps it would be best to dance just like Gran Alegria?
choice_data_list: True, you're right! I'll give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Trainer.
Do your best!

...After dancing 'GIRLS' LEGEND U'
over and over, I've gradually begun to understand.
『Wow Wow Wow Wow...』
choice_data_list: (This is the very first pose right after this.)

text_block_list.text:
Waiting with a solemn heart for the curtain to rise—
and striking the opening pose with a snap!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Phew! My rules!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
To finish off our roadwork, we do the
"GIRLS' LEGEND U" pose in the stands!
choice_data_list: Snap!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
Trainer-san, aren't you completely flawless?!
choice_data_list: Did I pass?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Pass, pass! A resounding pass!
I'm giving you a flower-stamp and infinite miles♪
choice_data_list: Alright, first My Rule cleared!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: My Rule: "Walk behind Rob Roy-senpai!" Complete♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! Let's do our best in training today too!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... why are you following behind me
too, Trainer...?
choice_data_list: Ah, sorry if that made you uncomfortable!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it at all!
I'm sorry, I just found it a little strange, is all...!
choice_data_list: I thought I'd try out Gran's my-rules

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, look at this!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My Rule! In short,
the "GIRLS' LEGEND U" pose!
choice_data_list: Snap!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
Even you, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Great! Gran and Trainer-san,
you're soooo cute death!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Aha, going head-on, huh?
Still, aren't we starting to feel like a great duo?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~ Right?!

"And then came the Asahi Hai FS—
As usual, the radio was playing in the waiting room."
I couldn't help but feel that Gran Alegria seemed somewhat low on energy.
choice_data_list: (Still, she seems to be focusing her mind, so...)

text_block_list.text:
For now, I placed the drink within her arm's reach
and decided to leave the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Thank you for earlier!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Those 3 miles were great—
my focus is really locked in!
choice_data_list: That's a relief!

text_block_list.text:
Many of her personal rules were aimed at keeping
her mind centered, and seemed to follow a fixed routine.
That's why I did my best not to get in her way.
choice_data_list: (Maybe I'm starting to get a feel for it, little by little!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, everyone's so fired up!
I can't afford to lose either!

In the paddock, Gran Alegria was
in her usual high spirits as ever.
choice_data_list: (Being able to control it yourself is amazing)
(Being able to control it yourself is amazing, isn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go claim
the title of our generation's Mile King!
